summary: A weak batch that needs a near-complete pass above Uncommon. Commons and Uncommons are mostly fine (cactus smugness, the hoverboard windmill, the tent zip at night, the dandelion clock that is always wrong), but the batch reads like a nature guide: about 60 Rares are plain facts or the object doing its job well (sunflower follows the sun, crutch keeps you steady, sprinkler waters the lawn) rather than a troublesome power; about 85 Epics are crowd or pretty-field scenes ('was worn by every helper at the garden party', 'bloomed across the field and the hill turned red'); and almost every Legendary is a quiet success or the banned 'has done X for N years' formula (fence fifty years, peony a hundred years, sharps bin 'for years without an accident'). All 115 Legendary names were 'The X That Y'; replacements now mix coined words, two-word titles and some epithets. Moves are mostly truthful, but 8 varied Ultimates carry effect words (heat on Compost Heap Steam, Lavender's Purple Haze Heat, Lily Scent Heat, Marsh Whisper Heat, Hot Motor Zoom; cold on Petal Snowfall; daze/crack on others), several attacks use defence or heal words (Splatter Shield, Safety Seal, Soothing Gel Smear, Big Perk Up, Shelter Shelter Shelter), and about 45 kit moves carry a garbled object suffix ('Stem Snare Tulip'). Cross-object copies: ficus L = Pilot 02 potted_plant E, begonia R = peace lily R, three flower Epics are the same field scene, tennis and volleyball net share the long-rally Epic, flower C = w11 incense R. Sensitive objects (sanitary bin, sharps bin, crutch, cane, life jacket, mushroom) are written neutrally; the mushroom's 'look and not pick' Rare is a good safety hook and is kept. Every high and medium item has a replacement; the patched batch validates and lints with 0 high / 0 medium, and all replacement names are unique across content/curated and the Pilot 01 names proposal.

patterns.pattern: Legendary name monotony: every Legendary name was 'The X That Y'.
patterns.suggestion: Replacement names mix one-word coinages, two-word titles and a minority of 'Name the Epithet'.

patterns.pattern: Years / quiet-success / award Legendaries: the Legendary is a small pleasant success, a show prize or 'has done X for N years' with no punchline.
patterns.suggestion: Each replacement is an outrageous feat with a concrete punchline.

patterns.pattern: Crowd Epics: 'was X by every Y at the Z' or a whole place turning one colour, with no single consequence or joke.
patterns.suggestion: Replacements give one concrete consequence with a joke.

patterns.pattern: Fact / job Rares: the Rare is a plain fact or the object doing its job, not a troublesome power.
patterns.suggestion: Replacements give a troublesome power tied to the object.

patterns.pattern: Varied Ultimates with effect words, Ultimates repeating the Epic name, and attack moves named with defence/heal/buff words.
Cross-object near-duplicates inside the batch and against other batches / Pilot 02.
patterns.suggestion: Keep one of each pair; replacements given for the other.

patterns.pattern: Sensitive objects kept neutral: sanitary bin (discreet, no bodily detail), sharps bin (safety and clinic framing, no handling), crutch and cane (empowering, fast), life jacket (rescue drama removed, still safe), mushroom (Rare teaches look-and-not-pick; no eating anywhere).
patterns.suggestion: Developer to confirm the framing; no further change proposed.

patterns.pattern: Pretty-field Epics: a dozen flower Epics are the same scene (bloomed across a field/hill/street and it turned one colour).
patterns.suggestion: Replacements give each flower a concrete consequence tied to its own trait.

patterns.suggestion: Drop the trailing object word where it does not collide with another move of the same monster (only a few are itemised).
